purpose: Copy of selected paper folders from a private repository, byte for byte except the files marked edited_after_copy (see post_copy_edits). Source texts only; no claim here is a status of this repository's DAG.

source.worktree_state: none of the kept files had uncommitted changes in the source working tree; every kept file is tracked at head_commit

copy_tool: python -I -X utf8 byte copy (shutil-free chunked read/write), sha256 computed during the copy

exclusion_rules.description: *.zip packaged snapshot of folders already copied (redundant opaque archives)
nested .gitignore / .gitattributes (would override repo-level attributes and hide files)
file not tracked at the_symbol_game HEAD (generated leftovers: egg-info, LaTeX aux/log/toc, scratch)
full copy of a published third-party paper (Witten, arXiv:1001.2933)

exclusion_notes: Each file is counted once under the first rule that matches (directory rules in the order D01..D08 across the whole path, then extension, name, source-tracking, third-party and size rules). Files under an excluded directory are not re-counted under extension rules.

patterns: api_key/secret/password/token assignments with a 24+ char value
secret_scan.note: test.key was seen in the source tree at lggr_iii_epk_gtla_overlay/.venv/Lib/site-packages/tornado/test/test.key; it is a third-party test fixture inside an excluded .venv and is not copied.

non_owner_email_like_strings.note: only test/placeholder strings (example.invalid fixtures and pytest decorator text); no real third-party addresses

absolute_local_paths_with_usernames.note: left as written in prose, logs and receipts
